title: Lest: формальное предостережение
description: Lest: формальное предостережение: словарь, грамматическая модель и авторский текст с разбором смысла и объяснениями ответов.
objectives: Использовать lest should в формальном контексте
notes: Lest readers should misunderstand — чтобы читатели не поняли неправильно.
Lest уже выражает нежелательность результата; дополнительное not может изменить смысл.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

public_payload.passage: The editor retained a short annotation lest readers should mistake a fictional case for a documented event. A colleague suggested removing the note because the example already sounded plausible. That plausibility was precisely why the annotation mattered. The editor was taking a precaution against misunderstanding; she was not reporting that every reader had already made the mistake. Nor was she trying to prevent readers from understanding the example. The final version kept both the example and its status clearly visible. This preserved the educational purpose while giving readers the information they needed to interpret the case accurately.

Taking a fictional case for a documented event.

exercises.editorial_answer: Taking a fictional case for a documented event.
